name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd

ledger.quote: Ahead of the festive season we expect volume growth of at least 15% quarter-on-quarter.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.target: Volume growth of at least 15% QoQ
ledger.verdict: Volume growth target of 15% QoQ for Q2 FY26 was not discussed on the latest call.

ledger.quote: Construction of our 0.8 million square feet. mobile manufacturing campus is progressing well in Noida for our anchor customers with much higher capacity and is expected to be completed by March ‘26.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

ledger.quote: Construction of our facility for display modules in which we have a 74:26 JV with HKC for first phase underway for smartphones and notebooks with trials to be commenced from Q4 this fiscal and commencement of mass production by Q1 of next fiscal.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.target: Mass production by Q1 next fiscal
ledger.verdict: Display module mass production missed the Q1 FY27 target and is now scheduled for Q3-Q4 FY27.
ledger.evidence: The response from various brands is very encouraging and the trial will start from the beginning of Q3 and mass production to commence from end of Q3 and beginning of Q4 this fiscal year.

ledger.quote: The outlook for ‘25, ‘26 is very promising with healthy order book, and we are confident of achieving 50% growth this fiscal.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Achieved 25.8% revenue growth in FY26 against the targeted 50% growth.

ledger.quote: Our construction for capacity expansion for FATL in Tirupati will be ready by August ‘25 to meet the increased order book for our customers.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: The FATL capacity expansion in Tirupati targeted for August 2025 was not discussed on the call.

ledger.quote: We feel that this number of INR7,000-odd crores can ramp up to almost INR11,000, 12,000 crores.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Ramp up to Rs 11,000-12,000 crore remains pending with no specific target deadline specified.

ledger.quote: In FY 26-27, we think we can expand the margins. Even after taking into account the PLI margin, which is our share of PLI margin going away, we can expand the margin to almost 120, 130 bps in FY 26-27and which should even be higher in FY 27-28
ledger.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

ledger.quote: In the next 6 to 9 months, investments would be made to expand the capacities and deepen the level of manufacturing.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Expanded capacities and deepened manufacturing across camera modules, display facilities, and molding capabilities within 9 months.
ledger.evidence: Construction of our display facility is completed and installation of machinery is going on for mobiles, IT hardware products and automotive displays.

ledger.quote: And we feel confident that the volume of smartphone camera modules can increase from 40 million units and revenues by INR 2,000 crores in large financial years to 190 to 200 million units per annum with the revenue closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores and sub-10% EBITDA margins in the next two to three years.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.target: 190 to 200 million units, revenue Rs 6,000-7,000 crores
ledger.verdict: Target of 190-200 million camera module units and Rs 6,000-7,000 crore revenue is pending for FY28-FY29.

ledger.quote: We are in active discussion with another large ODM of smartphones and the manufacturing for them should start by Q4 of FY 25-26.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Manufacturing start for large ODM missed the Q4 FY26 target and is expected to commence in Q3 FY27.
ledger.evidence: We received the PN3 approval for our JV with Vivo in July '26, and we are now working towards the consummation of the transaction. We expect the JV to commence operations and start reflecting in our revenues from Q3 of the current fiscal.

ledger.quote: Our new facility in Chennai will be operational by Q4 of this fiscal.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Chennai facility launch missed the Q4 FY26 deadline and is operational starting August 2026.
ledger.evidence: Our new facility in Chennai will be operational starting August '26 with expanded capacity to meet the demand of our anchor customer.

ledger.quote: So, initially, this business, I feel is going to be around $150 billion (Market size). That is the new category. On an overall basis, we feel that in couple of years, this business should be somewhere around close to $1 billion.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Target of bringing telecom business close to $1 billion in a couple of years remains pending.

ledger.quote: We feel that the IT business for us in next two years should be around Rs. 4,000 crores to Rs. 5,000 crores business.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.target: IT business Rs 4,000 to Rs 5,000 crores
ledger.verdict: Target of Rs 4,000-5,000 crore IT business by FY28 remains pending with Q1 FY27 achieving Rs 1,350 crore.

ledger.quote: Our new 4,000 square feet facility for 74:26 launch at JV for manufacturing of smartphones and other electronic devices is expected to start operations by Q2 of '26-'27.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.target: Start operations of new smartphone JV facility
ledger.verdict: Smartphone JV facility operations start was pushed from Q2 FY27 to Q3 FY27 following PN3 approval.
ledger.evidence: We received the PN3 approval for our JV with Vivo in July '26, and we are now working towards the consummation of the transaction. We expect the JV to commence operations and start reflecting in our revenues from Q3 of the current fiscal.

ledger.quote: In the first phase, we are creating a capacity of 24 million per annum for smartphones and 2 million units per annum for notebooks, largely captive consumption and automotive combined and trial should commence by Q2 of next fiscal.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.target: Create phase 1 capacity and commence trials
ledger.verdict: Display facility trials shifted from Q2 FY27 to beginning of Q3 FY27 with construction now completed.
ledger.evidence: The response from various brands is very encouraging and the trial will start from the beginning of Q3 and mass production to commence from end of Q3 and beginning of Q4 this fiscal year.

ledger.quote: Our expansion into new category of semi-automatic washing machines in 16 kg and 18 kg capacity is completed and mass production to start in March '26, which will be in the first across the industry.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.target: Start mass production of semi-automatic washing machines
ledger.verdict: Mass production of 16kg and 18kg semi-automatic washing machines was successfully commenced as planned.
ledger.evidence: We have started manufacturing semi-automatic washing machine in the higher capacity categories of 16 and 18 kg, which is the first across the industries.

ledger.quote: Our new Tirupati facility for front-loading washing machine is ready and mass production to start by Q2 financial year '26-'27 with annual capacity of 300,000 units.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.target: Start mass production at Tirupati front-loading facility
ledger.verdict: Mass production at Tirupati front-loading washing machine facility moved from Q2 FY27 to Q3 FY27.
ledger.evidence: Addition of our new manufacturing facility in Tirupati will expand our capacities from 0.6 million units per annum by another 0.3 million units per annum, including fully automatic front-loading washing machine 9, which will be launched in Q3 of this fiscal.

ledger.quote: We have bagged order for desktops from one of our customers and we will start manufacturing in Q4 of this fiscal in Chennai, and also, in active discussion with an existing customer for manufacturing of tablets.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Desktop manufacturing in Chennai started as planned and is currently operational.
ledger.evidence: Our IT hardware product manufacturing unit in Chennai is rapidly evolving into India's largest IT hardware manufacturing campus, where we currently manufacture notebooks, desktops and AIOs

ledger.quote: The new facility being developed ascend to our existing facility under our 60:40 JV with Inventec is near completion and mass production of SSD and memory modules is planned to begin in Q2 of '26-'27
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall

ledger.verdict: Mass production of SSD modules moved from Q2 FY27 to Q3 FY27.
ledger.evidence: will start manufacturing SSD from Q3 and also exploring other critical components such as power supplies and mechanicals, which will enhance value addition and margins.

ledger.quote: We will be expanding the capacities of camera module and a subsidiary Q Tech, which is an ECMS beneficiary for smartphones from 70 million units annually to around 180 million units to 190 million units annually over the next 15 to 18 months, largely catering to our captive smartphone volumes in addition to deepening the level of manufacturing, capturing more value add in India.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Camera module expansion to 180-190 million units remains pending for completion by late 2027.

ledger.quote: We expect this vertical to deliver high double-digit revenue growth in the current fiscal.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: High double-digit revenue growth target for current fiscal FY27 remains pending.

ledger.quote: The segment delivered a healthy performance for the quarter under review, and we expect 3x growth in the revenues in the current fiscal against last year with a huge uptake in order books from all customers.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Target of 3x revenue growth in current fiscal FY27 remains pending.

ledger.quote: Addition of a new manufacturing facility in Tirupati will expand our capacities from 0.6 million units per annum by another 0.3 million units, including fully automatic front-loading washing machine, which will be launched by end of Q2 this financial year.
ledger.speaker: Atul Lall

ledger.evidence: Addition of our new manufacturing facility in Tirupati will expand our capacities from 0.6 million units per annum by another 0.3 million units per annum, including fully automatic front-loading washing machine 9, which will be launched in Q3 of this fiscal.

ledger.speaker: Atul Lall
ledger.verdict: Target of over Rs 4,000 crore IT revenue in FY27 is pending, with Q1 delivering Rs 1,350 crore.

read: Management demonstrates strong execution capability in scaling revenues and onboarding strategic joint venture partners, though project timelines frequently suffer minor delays of one to two quarters. Investors should account for optimistic growth guidance, as seen in the FY26 revenue shortfall and deferred margin expansion targets.
questions: Why have display module trials and mass production timelines been pushed to Q3 and Q4 FY27?
What caused the delay in launching front-loading washing machines and SSD manufacturing to Q3 FY27?
How will management offset short-term operating margin compression following the expiry of Mobile PLI 1?
bull: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 21.1% YoY to Rs 15,548 crore despite smartphone market volume contraction.
IT hardware vertical generated Rs 1,350 crore in Q1 FY27, matching full-year FY26 performance.
Chennai desktop manufacturing operationalized as planned, strengthening non-mobile manufacturing capabilities.
bear: FY26 revenue growth reached 25.8%, missing management's 50% growth target of Rs 58,000+ crore.
Q1 FY27 operating margin compressed to 3.0% due to Mobile PLI 1 sunset and input costs.
Multiple facility ramp-ups, including Noida mobile and Tirupati washing machines, faced quarter-to-quarter delays.
